    • getData

      @Nullable public PlayerData getData(Player player)
      Get an instance of a player's data if player is in a game

      This will first check if a player is playing in a game, then check if they are spectating a game.
      If you would like specific data use getPlayerData(Player) or getSpectatorData(Player)

      Parameters:
      player - Player to get data for
      Returns:
      PlayerData from player, null if player is not in a game
